---
title: "Instacart Dashboard"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)

data("instacart")

set.seed(123)

instacart_sample =
  instacart |>
  slice_sample(n = 50000)
```

Column {data-width=550}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Aisle popularity and reorder rate (aisles with more than 1,000 items)

```{r scatterplot}
instacart |>
  group_by(department, aisle) |>
  summarize(
    n_items = n(),
    reorder_rate = mean(reordered),
    .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(n_items > 1000) |>
  mutate(
    text_label =
      str_c("Aisle: ", aisle,
            "\nDepartment: ", department,
            "\nItems: ", n_items,
            "\nReorder rate: ", round(reorder_rate, 3))) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~n_items,
    y = ~reorder_rate,
    color = ~department,
    text = ~text_label,
    hoverinfo = "text",
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    marker = list(size = 9, opacity = 0.7),
    colors = "viridis") |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Number of items ordered", type = "log"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Proportion of items reordered"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Department")))
```

Column {data-width=450}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Days since prior order

```{r histogram}
instacart |>
  filter(!is.na(days_since_prior_order)) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~days_since_prior_order,
    type = "histogram",
    nbinsx = 31,
    marker = list(color = "#21908CFF")) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Days since prior order"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number of items ordered"),
    bargap = 0.05)
```

### Hour of day, by department

```{r boxplot}
instacart_sample |>
  mutate(
    department = fct_reorder(
      department, order_hour_of_day)) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~department,
    y = ~order_hour_of_day,
    color = ~department,
    type = "box",
    colors = "viridis") |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Department"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Hour of day"),
    showlegend = FALSE)
```
